method: Extract per-screen state constructors (activity/skeleton = loading, empty_state/splash = empty, error_state/banner = failure) via scripts/quality/audit-state-surfaces.py into states.json, then judge per app whether loading, empty, offline, expired-credential and malformed-content failures read as distinct states with honest copy, using the error-producer strings in source. Local-only apps need empty + malformed/save-error only; credential apps must also distinguish missing/rejected credentials from network failure.

arxiv.notes: Public API, no credentials needed. Loading: skeleton + activity. Empty: three distinct splashes (library/saved/listing). Malformed distinct: 'arXiv sent something unreadable' + 'That rendering was not text'. Offline: row-level 'offline - summary' markers plus listing trouble strings; in-flight guards ('already loading') are a separate truthful class. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:612-1209.

audiobook.notes: Loading: activity. Empty: empty_state distinct from shelf-unreadable error_state. Malformed distinct per stage ('The script/research came back malformed'). Credentials: checked_secrets() gates before anything is spent; missing key reads 'Permission needed' and names the file. Offline: created books play offline; creation needs network and says so. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:88,241,286,562-570 + pipeline.rs:271-359.

backgammon.notes: Local game, no network/credentials by design. Save is versioned (autosave-v4 with v3 migration); restore parsers are Option-based so a corrupt snapshot falls back instead of showing a false state. No loading state needed (instant). Evidence: states.json + main.rs:13-14,512,930-949.

birds.notes: Loading: activity. Empty vs failure distinct: splash 'The snapshot could not be read' carries the detail text (malformed snapshot), while fetch errors surface as attention banners from the error string (network class). Offline named in signals. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:51-201.

brief.notes: Textbook differentiation: offline ('The reader is offline. The brief below is the one already saved.') vs empty-result ('The refresh brought back nothing.') vs save-failure ('could not be saved for offline reading') vs malformed ('This story arrived empty.') vs empty shelf splash. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:595,685,995,1327.

calibre-web.notes: Textbook failure classifier catalog::failure (catalog.rs:96-108): NoCredential ('Add it from your computer') vs Unauthorized ('The library refused this account') vs Offline ('Connect to Wi-Fi... Your current catalog is kept') vs Unreachable - distinct copy plus state preservation. Loading skeleton, connect splash, offline reading screens with Retry loading/Download again/Retry saving. Evidence: states.json + catalog.rs + reading.rs:59-107.

chat.notes: Malformed replies differentiated ('The reply was not text' / 'could not be read' / 'answered with no message in it'); missing credential distinct with exact remedy ('No key is installed... kobo secret set'). Empty splash + banner + activity. Evidence: states.json + conversation.rs:544-581 + main.rs:544.

crossword.notes: Local app, puzzles bundled. load_error Option with Retry save guidance ('Saves are confirmed by storage... Unreadable records are kept intact'); no network states by design; load is instant (loaded flag gates first paint). Evidence: states.json + main.rs:27,46-64.

deck.notes: Failure classes distinct: 'That command is still running' (busy) vs 'That control changed. Refreshing the deck' (stale) vs 'That result is no longer available' (expired) vs 'This command produced no output' (empty result) vs pairing-code guidance. Activity + banner surfaces. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:210-532.

fanshelf.notes: Rate-limit distinct (SLOW_DOWN 'The archive asked us to slow down - try in a minute'), malformed download distinct ('The downloaded EPUB could not be opened'), shelf-full distinct, six empty splashes per collection, skeleton loading. Unauthorized/credential signals handled via account setup. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:33,915.

fieldbook.notes: Local app, packs pushed via CLI. Pack-shelf failure distinct ('could not be opened'), empty-pack splash distinct with the push remedy named, search-no-match distinct, outing/empty-log states separate. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:218-720.

flashcards.notes: Import error taxonomy: incompatible package vs damaged deck vs no reviewable cards, each with distinct remedy; collection open vs read failures distinct; damaged-image and missing-font states named. Empty state + skeleton loading. Evidence: states.json + import.rs:22-27 + main.rs:220-873.

frame.notes: Failure classes distinct: single photo unreadable vs no photo on shelf readable ('Re-push the album') vs transfer-record mismatch ('Re-push it from your computer') vs picture budget. Empty frame splash. Activity surfaces for loads. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:150-454.

gallery.notes: Component catalog: state specimens are the content itself, reviewed under APPQA-05 (captions fix + 27/27 matrix). Counted for census completeness.

grimoire.notes: Local reference app, bundled document. Empty states distinct per collection (no match / no reference selected / no combatants / no party); malformed covered by 'This reference has no text in the bundled document'. No network states by design. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:494-808.

gutenbird.notes: OPDS failure classes distinct: catalog answer unreadable vs catalog-has-no-search vs download-too-large vs book unreadable; offline dictionary section with honest empty state naming the exact remedy folder. Banners + activity + skeleton. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:1031-2707.

habits.notes: Local app. Load failure is honest degraded-mode copy ('Could not open local habits... You can use an empty session, but changes may not persist') distinct from empty states; weekly summary states distinct. Skeleton loading. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:291-530.

hn.notes: Malformed distinct per surface ('This article arrived empty', 'That tab came back empty'), save-vs-kept states distinct ('could not be kept' vs 'open but not kept'), no-thread distinct. Empty/skeleton/activity present. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:349-1203.

homepanel.notes: Textbook TaskError classifier: NoCredential with exact remedy ('kobo secret set homeassistant') vs Offline ('No network. Join Wi-Fi') vs Denied; stale-data honesty banner ('Offline since HH:MM. Readings may be stale.') - exemplary freshness differentiation. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:127-229.

inkling.notes: Deterministic offline daily puzzle, no network by design. Save integrity: full validation before replace ('a bad save cannot replace anything'), LoadState Pending/Ready gates first paint; archive-play honesty ('do not change statistics and are not saved'). Evidence: states.json + main.rs:1-8,478,605,876-932.

kitchencard.notes: Offline distinct with kept-state honesty ('Off the air. Saved recipes still cook.'), missing credential with exact remedy, offline-storage-limit distinct, empty/no-steps states separate. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:112-492.

lichess.notes: Offline training mode distinct from online play; 'Token rejected' banner (expired credentials) distinct from network failure; solution-unreadable vs challenge-expired vs opponent-disconnected states all separate. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:531-914.

logicpack.notes: Local app. Save corruption distinct and non-destructive ('This saved record could not be read.' + 'Your saved puzzles have been kept.'); restart consequences honest and undoable. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:410-887.

magnet.notes: Hardware-state taxonomy instead of network states: no hall sensor vs build-cannot-read vs permission-not-asked vs sensor-read failure, each with distinct honest copy. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:379-573.

morse.notes: Local app, bundled code table. Failure modes covered: empty-send ('There is nothing here to send') and timing failure ('The beacon could not keep time, so it stopped'). No network/credential states by design. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:578-668.

musicstand.notes: Empty stand vs score-no-longer-on-shelf vs page-over-budget vs crop-failure vs page-unreadable ('Re-push the score') - all distinct with remedies. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:308-562.

needles.notes: Malformed transfer distinct with exact remedy command vs no-pattern-yet with exact push command vs cancelled-sync notice; per-collection empty states. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:326-967.

nonograms.notes: Import validation taxonomy: manifest not text / names no puzzles / too many / photo unreadable / unfair puzzle - each distinct; board-fit honesty ('cannot fit at this display size'). Evidence: states.json + photo.rs:36-107 + view.rs:211.

panels.notes: Server failures distinct from content failures: unexpected download vs changed-on-server vs too-large-to-keep vs settings-unreadable/unsaved (storage pressure named). Evidence: states.json + transfer.rs:137-150 + server.rs:45-174.

paperterm.notes: Connection-state honesty: OFF_AIR 'Connection lost. Reconnecting.' distinct from pairing/trust/address-error flows; preview explicitly labeled sample ('Nothing is running on your computer'); retry-vs-continue-without-saving on pairing failure. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:27 + onboarding.rs.

parlor.notes: Local board games. Illegal-move feedback is specific per cause ('brackets no opposing discs', 'has no legal move', 'cannot move') distinct from game-over and house-thinking states; save/resume via menu. No network states by design. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:595-828.

parser.notes: Story interpreter: parser-feedback states are the fiction's own voice ('The story does not know that word', 'No path that way'), SAVE/RESTORE named in-world; story-file validation is shared with the CLI (PARSERCLI). No network states by design. Evidence: states.json + story.rs:344-402.

post.notes: Malformed vs network vs cached-state preservation all distinct: 'answered with something other than letters. Your cached list is unchanged' vs 'Couldn't connect - ... Your cached letters are still here' vs 'Couldn't read the gateway's answer. The reply stays queued.' Connect-gateway setup state separate. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:303-340.

pubquiz.notes: Offline distinct with kept-state honesty ('Off the air. Existing packs still play offline.'), empty-mix vs no-category distinct, no-points state separate. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:339-1759.

readlater.notes: Storage-limit vs load-failure-with-preservation ('Current articles are unchanged') vs per-tab empty states vs signed-in/expired-credential guidance ('Run kobo readlater login to switch accounts') vs connect splash. Evidence: states.json + main.rs:179-416.
